property_summary: Only the original admin can change the owner; the bug allows the current owner (who may not be admin) to also change it, violating the intended access control.
For any caller, if setOwner succeeds, the new owner must equal the original admin; the mutant allows a non-admin caller to set the owner to an arbitrary address, breaking this invariant.
After a call to setOwner by a non-admin caller that succeeds, the owner must not have changed; the mutant allows the current owner (who is not admin) to change owner to an arbitrary address.

For any caller, if the caller is not the original deployer, setOwner must revert because only the admin can change the owner; the buggy version allows the current owner (who may not be the deployer) to succeed, violating admin-only access control.
For any caller, if setOwner succeeds, the new owner must equal the caller; the mutant allows the current owner to set the owner to an arbitrary different address, breaking this invariant.
For any caller, setOwner(address) must either succeed and update owner, or revert; the buggy modifier always reverts, so owner can never be changed.
